title: 100pct stacked show absolute totals
rule: 100% stacked bars must show absolute totals — percentages hide count; give the total per category so scale is judgeable.
pass_when: 100% stacked bars include the absolute total per category.
overview: 100% stacked bars must show absolute totals per category, not percentages alone.
apply_when: Rendering 100% stacked bar charts by category.
not_when: 100% stacked bars that show percentages only with no absolute totals.
agent_hint: Add absolute totals per category on 100% stacked bars; percentages alone hide scale.
description: 100% stacked bars must show absolute totals per category. Percentages alone hide count, so the total is needed for scale to be judgeable. Pass when 100% stacked bars include the absolute total per category alongside the percentage stack. Fail when they show percentages only, leaving readers unable to judge real magnitudes behind the 100% bars.
do_not_claim: Honest zero baseline as this totals row.
